name: Twelve-bar walking blues
desc: A real 12-bar blues form in Eb: the bass walks the I-I-I-I / IV-IV-I-I / V-IV-I-V changes over a 12-cycle pattern in 12/8 shuffle time, triplet-elongated root-3-5-6 boxes like a Willie Dixon line. The form IS the phrase — arcs land on bar 12 turnarounds.
